title: check.py refuses a path:line citation in _answers.md or _gaps.md that points at a line with none of the cited sources
goal: Retrospective of SP-wgx4pq4r: ST-fxly2caj and BG-nozwqz2j inserted lines into claude/hooks.md and had to re-point the claude/hooks.md:N citations in _answers.md and _gaps.md by hand; one (hooks.md:133, now :160) had already been stale since an earlier change, and no gate noticed. check.py fails, naming the ledger line and the citation, when a (path:line) citation in a root's _answers.md or _gaps.md (the full path:line form and the :N shorthand that follows one) names a line that is no fact: a heading, a table or Reference row, a blank line or a line past the end, with which lines of a wrapped fact bullet count and whether the cited fact must share a source id with the ledger bullet as the gate 'citable-line' answers; the citations in the tree that the answered rule rejects are re-pointed to the facts they mean (kb/public/_answers.md), kb/_self/content-rules.md states the rule, one planted-failure test within the ceiling proves it, and check.py passes on the tree.

gates.question: Which ledger path:line citations should check.py accept? A plan-time run over kb/public (117 citations, :N shorthand included) finds 22 that do not name the first line of a fact bullet, 19 of them a continuation or tag line inside a tagged wrapped bullet, and 5 whose cited fact shares no source id with the ledger bullet (DER answers citing the facts they derive from).

ST-ctomsu4i is a parked draft (parked: SP-wgx4pq4r close) whose notes name no fitness test it blocks and no real user's report, so kb/_self/backlog.md (Sprints, Plan) keeps it out of a sprint; the operator listed it for this sprint. Commit it on the operator's selection, or move it out?

notes: Premise run 2026-10-08 at plan (a probe over kb/public/_answers.md and _gaps.md, 117 path:line citations with the :N shorthand): 22 problems, all in kb/public/_answers.md. 3 name no fact at all (claude/plugins.md:106 and :107, Reference table rows; gitlab/git-test-repositories.md:144, a heading); 14 name a continuation or tag line inside a tagged wrapped fact bullet (git-test-repositories.md:66, 102, 106, 109, 113, 123, 126, 128, 135, 138, 147, 153, 160, 164); 5 name a fact sharing no source id with the ledger bullet (git-test-repositories.md:70, :91; python/interpreter-startup.md:40, 45, 56). The triage's 17 of 79 counted only the full path:line form and first lines; 13 of those were first lines of wrapped facts, which are fine. Correction to gate citable-line's question: it is 14 continuation or tag lines, not 19. With the recommended answer (any line of a tagged fact bullet, no id rule) 3 citations are re-pointed; premise reproduces. Selected by the operator for SP-caqrexqw on 2026-10-08: wrong ledger citations send a reader of a recorded answer to a line that does not state it; the notes name no fitness test, so gate promote asks whether it joins. Passes before the work (precheck 2026-10-08): check.py pins that the tree passes once the new rule lands, which needs the rejected citations re-pointed; selfdoc.py stale --work ST-ctomsu4i pins that the item's commits leave no doc stale (it judges only commits naming the item, so none yet). The planted-failure test -k ledger_citation is the check that fails until the work is done. Passes before the work: python3 _tools/check.py (pins the tree green once the rule lands) and python3 _tools/selfdoc.py stale --work ST-ctomsu4i (pins the item's docs current).
